SELECT DISTINCT u.id, ua.username AS username, u.real_name AS realName, u.phone, u.email, u.skill_level AS skillLevel FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN user_auth ua ON u.id = ua.user_id AND ua.enabled = 1 INNER JOIN user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id INNER JOIN role r ON ur.role_id = r.id AND r.role_code = 'ROLE_WORKER'
AND u.skill_level = #{skillLevel}
AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ua.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY u.skill_level DESC, u.id ASC
